player_note: The description (28 May 2000) says: "This is the CCT Skrilling deck that I used to help me WIN the California State Championship." The strategy says he beat a Mind What You Have Learned deck (by 17), Hard Core Profit (by 18) and, in the final game, an Obi's Hut/Tosche Station deck (by 15). His page notes he was listed as 2000 California State Champion on Red 32's site; a later rebuild is [[Clayton Atkin Atkin's CCT Skrillings V2 0]].
